+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+import requests
+
+
+def _base_url() -> str:
+    return os.environ.get("DATADOG_LOGS_API_URL", "https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com/api/v2/logs")
+
+
+def _api_key() -> str:
+    key = os.environ.get("DATADOG_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise RuntimeError("DATADOG_API_KEY is required")
+    return key
+
+
+def _correlation_id() -> str:
+    return os.environ.get("REQUEST_ID") or os.environ.get("CORRELATION_ID") or os.urandom(16).hex()
+
+
+def write_correlated_logs(message: str, level: str = "info", service: str = "application") -> dict:
+    correlation_id = _correlation_id()
+    payload = {
+        "data": [
+            {
+                "ddsource": "python",
+                "service": service,
+                "message": message,
+                "status": level,
+                "ddtags": f"correlation_id:{correlation_id}",
+                "attributes": {
+                    "correlation_id": correlation_id,
+                    "request_id": correlation_id,
+                    "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                },
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        _base_url(),
+        headers={
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+            "DD-API-KEY": _api_key(),
+        },
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return {"correlation_id": correlation_id, "status_code": response.status_code}
+
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: write_structured_log.py
+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+import requests
+
+
+DATADOG_URL = os.getenv("DATADOG_LOGS_API_URL", "https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com/api/v2/logs")
+DATADOG_API_KEY = os.getenv("DATADOG_API_KEY")
+
+
+def write_structured_log(message, service=None, level="info", **fields):
+    if not DATADOG_API_KEY:
+        raise ValueError("DATADOG_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload = {
+        "ddsource": "python",
+        "service": service or os.getenv("DD_SERVICE", "app"),
+        "status": level,
+        "message": message,
+        "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+    }
+    payload.update(fields)
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        DATADOG_URL,
+        headers={
+            "DD-API-KEY": DATADOG_API_KEY,
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps([payload]),
+        timeout=10,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return {"status_code": response.status_code, "provider": "datadog"}
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(0)
*** End Patch
